title: Telemetry provenance redaction & legal-hold coordinator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a provenance-aware ingestion layer and a legal-hold coordinator that: (1) applies schema-driven redaction at ingest while storing minimal provenance metadata for debugging and compliance, (2) tags and routes legal-hold events to an immutable long-retain store with auditable access, and (3) exposes an idempotent, monotonic deletion marker for downstream analytics pipelines so retention workflows can safely skip or archive data when required. This ticket covers design, infra changes, ingest adapters, backfill strategy, and acceptance criteria to unblock Console analytics retention requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest adapters apply configured redaction rules (per-event schema) and emit a provenance header that is persisted alongside event metadata.
Legal-hold tagged events are routed immediately to long-retain storage and are excluded from regular retention deletion runs.
Deletion markers (erasure_marker_v2) can be written and observed by downstream consumers; running retention job removes non-held items while preserving held items.
All access to long-retain store is logged and accessible via the Console audit view (links to sample query results).
Privacy engineering approves the design; security review completed and sign-off recorded.
End-to-end tests simulated on staging: ingest -> redaction -> legal-hold tagging -> retention run behaves as expected.
technical_notes: Add lightweight provenance metadata: source_checksum (SHA256 of raw event, stored encrypted), origin_host, ingest_timestamp, schema_version.
Redaction rules driven by schema: maintain a ConfigService table 'schema_redaction_v2' keyed by model/schema name; rule types: redact, zero_out, pseudonymize (salted HMAC).

Legal-hold implementation: boolean tag 'legal_hold:true' and 'legal_hold_reason' string; route to 'long-retain' S3 bucket with server-side encryption + KMS; retention job checks this flag before deleting.
Introduce 'erasure_marker_v2' event written to the control topic (Kafka) with {key, marker_ts, scope, reason}; consumers must idempotently honor markers.
Backfill strategy: streaming reingest for last 90 days via a bounded job (kafka replay) that applies redaction and marks provenance for events without checksum; cost estimate attached in Confluence.
Ensure cross-region replication preserves legal-hold and provenance tags; add integration test in replication harness.
review_feedback: PM (Jordan): Keep raw event checksum for debugging but encrypt and rotate keys monthly — agreed and added to technical notes.
Privacy (Dr. Kim): Prefer pseudonymization over reversible hashing for user identifiers to enable privacy-preserving joins — adjusted rule set to support salted HMAC pseudonyms.
Infra (Ravi): Long-retain bucket must have lifecycle rule to move to Glacier after 365 days unless a legal-hold exists — added to rollout checklist.
Security (Elena): Add KMS key separation for long-retain vs standard telemetry buckets — queued as follow-up task.

2026-02-28 Dr. Kim (Privacy): Reviewed config-driven approach; asked for pseudonymization option. Updated design doc to include salted HMAC pseudonymizer.

2026-03-11 Marcus: Submitted PR for ingest adapter: github.com/redwood-inference/console-analytics/pull/7281 — awaiting infra tests.

2026-03-12 QA: Beginning staging E2E tests for redaction + legal-hold flow; first run found a race where retention job ran before consumer processed erasure_marker_v2 — adding gating to retention job.
risk: Potential risk around retroactive deletion for derived datasets and timing races between erasure_marker publication and retention job. Cross-cluster replication may duplicate legal-hold tags if not synchronized. Backfill cost and query performance for long-retain store need monitoring.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (staging): Integration tests + canary on internal telemetry for 7 days.
Phase 1 (limited prod): Enable for 10% of Console traffic; monitor retention runs and audit logs.
Phase 2 (wide): Enable for all Console telemetry; run backfill windowed job for 90 days; monitor cost/dx.
Fallback: If retention job races or schema mismatch occurs, toggle ingest adapter to 'redact-only' fallback and pause backfill.
